claim.statement: V8.44 is validated: eyesd resolves watcher profiles at tick/request time, so a new project profile authored after daemon startup can be run by `eyes tick` without restarting the daemon.

evidence.summary: `cargo test` passed. Integration test starts eyesd, writes a new `late` profile under `.eyes/watchers`, then runs `eyes tick late` successfully against the already-running daemon.

information_depth.rationale: The test explicitly authors the profile after daemon readiness and before the tick request.
